description:
Get fine-mapped credible sets and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table credible_set — one record = one fine-mapped credible set (study locus) of one study.
Key: studyLocusId.
Arguments: study_locus_id accepts study locus id (resolved; unknown -> error); study_id accepts gwas study (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by credibleSetlog10BF desc (upstream sorts every match); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown credibleSetlog10BF are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Fine-mapped credible sets of OT 25.09 GWAS and molecular-QTL studies; absence means no credible set.

min_confidence.description: Keeps rows with credibleSetlog10BF >= this value; unknown values never pass.

study_id.description: Accepts gwas_study; resolved to one gwas_study (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

study_locus_id.description: Accepts study_locus_id; resolved to one study_locus_id (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
